SELECT
    cohort_year,
    count() AS cohort_size,
    sum(returned) AS returned_customers,
    returned_customers / cohort_size AS retention_fraction
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        toYear(min(DateKey)) AS cohort_year,
        max(toYear(DateKey)) > toYear(min(DateKey)) AS returned
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
